title.narrative: Programa de Crdito Subnacional para Infraestructura Pblica, Servicios Pblicos
Subnational Credit for Infrastructure, Public Services and Projects- III

description.narrative: El objetivo del programa, que coincide con el del CCLIP ME-X1002), es contribuir a la mejora de la infraestructura pblica, los servicios pblicos y al fortalecimiento de la capacidad institucional de los Gobiernos Subnacionales (GSN) y EntidadesPrestadoras de Servicios Pblicos (EPSP). Los objetivos especficos del programa son: (i) ampliar el financiamiento de inversin dirigido a los GSN y EPSP; (ii) fortalecer los GSN en las reas de planificacin, gestin fiscal y gestin de inversiones, entre otras, en un marco de sostenibilidad fiscal y financiera; y (iii) ampliar los programas innovadores de asistencia tcnica e inversiones dirigidos a los GSN y EPSP.

The program's objective, which coincides with that of the CCLIP ME-X1002, is to contribute to the improvement of public infrastructure, public services and institutional strenghtening of GSN and EPSP. The specific objectives of the program are: (i) increase investment financing aimed at GSN and EPSP; (ii) strengthen GSN in areas such as planning, fiscal and investments management, amongst others, in a fiscal and financial sustainable framework; and (iii) expand the innovation programs of technical assistence and investments directed to the GSN and EPSP.
